t-cold.text: A simple pendulum moves back and forth in what we call an oscillatory motion.

t-swing.text: You can watch it swing from one side to the other.

t-ans1.text: One oscillation is completed when the bob starts at the mean position, moves to extreme position A,

t-ans2.text: goes to extreme position B, and then returns to the mean position.

t-whatif.text: By increasing the pendulum's length to 1.5 m, the time period becomes longer, meaning each swing takes more time.

s-l1.text: Not long after that, the good old man dreamed again,

s-l2.text: Take the ashes of the mill, sprinkle them on the withered trees, and they will bloom again.

leader.text: Get down on your knees! Get down on your knees!

imagine.text: Imagine if the old man climbed down to kneel quietly...

q2.text: Dog-Spirit, why did you help the old man?

dog-a.text: I helped him because he was always so kind to me. And I wanted to bring him joy and wonder, just like he brought to me.
